agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (17.1 and 18.3 mass) undergo a close fast encounter (distance 1.45 at step 9, speeds ~9.2 and ~2.9). Substeps only grow 10->11 despite kinetic energy more than doubling (325->800), so the fixed-dt leapfrog with adaptive substepping under-resolves the strong softened-gravity forces. Pairwise forces are then not equal-and-opposite to solver precision, producing net total-momentum and angular-momentum drift at step 9. Reducing dt removes the failure.
